title: workflow
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): activeworkflowid, createdby, createdonbehalfby, flowgroup_flowgroupid, licensee_systemuserid, licenseentitledby_workflowid, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, ownerid, owningbusinessunit, owningteam, owninguser, parentworkflowid.

asyncautodelete.description: Indicates whether the asynchronous system job is automatically deleted on completion.

billingcontext.description: Billing context this flow is in.

clientdata.description: Business logic converted into client data

connectionreferences.description: Connection References related to this workflow.

createdon.description: Date and time when the process was created.

createstage.description: Stage of the process when triggered on Create.

definition.description: Definition of the business logic of this workflow instance.

deletestage.description: Stage of the process when triggered on Delete.

dependencies.description: Soft dependencies of this workflow instance.

desktopflowmodules.description: Desktop flow modules related to this workflow.

dynamicssolutioncontext.description: comma separated list of one or more Dynamics First Party Solution Unique names that this workflow is in context of.

entityimage.description: Shows the default image for the record.

formid.description: Unique identifier of the associated form.

introducedversion.description: Version in which the form is introduced.

iscrmuiworkflow.description: Indicates whether the process was created using the Microsoft Dynamics 365 Web application.

iscustomizable.description: Information that specifies whether this component can be customized.

iscustomprocessingstepallowedforotherpub.description: Defines whether other publishers can attach custom processing steps to this action

ismanaged.description: Indicates whether the solution component is part of a managed solution.

istransacted.description: Whether or not the steps in the process are executed in a single transaction.

mode.description: Shows the mode of the process.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the process was last modified.

modifymetadata.description: Flow modify metadata used for telemetry, etc.

ondemand.description: Indicates whether the process is able to run as an on-demand process.

processorder.description: Type the business process flow order.

processroleassignment.description: Contains the role assignment for the process.

processtriggerformid.description: Unique identifier of the associated form for process trigger.

rank.description: Indicates the rank for order of execution for the synchronous workflow.

runas.description: Specifies the system user account under which a workflow executes.

solutionid.description: Unique identifier of the associated solution.

statuscode.description: Reason for the status of the workflow

subprocess.description: Indicates whether the process can be included in other processes as a child process.

syncworkflowlogonfailure.description: Select whether synchronous workflow failures will be saved to log files.

triggeroncreate.description: Indicates whether the process will be triggered when the primary entity is created.

triggerondelete.description: Indicates whether the process will be triggered on deletion of the primary entity.

triggeronupdateattributelist.description: Attributes that trigger the process when updated.

uiflowtype.description: Type of the UI Flow process.

updatestage.description: Select the stage a process will be triggered on update.

_activeworkflowid_value.description: Unique identifier of the latest activation record for the process.

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the process.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the process.

_flowgroup_value.description: Flow group the flow is associated with.

_licensee_value.description: The user object that should be used to establish the license the flow should operate under.

_licenseentitledby_value.description: The source of the license entitlements.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who last modified the process.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who last modified the process.

_ownerid_value.description: Unique identifier of the user or team who owns the process.

_owningbusinessunit_value.description: Unique identifier of the business unit that owns the process.

_owningteam_value.description: Unique identifier of the team who owns the process.

_owninguser_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who owns the process.

_parentworkflowid_value.description: Unique identifier of the definition for process activation.
